protocol.decision_rule: >=9/16 improving AND >=9/16 improving with p < alpha (train._ablation_summary)

F1-M.rule: claim only if a metric has >=9/16 improving cells and >=9/16 improving cells with paired bootstrap p-value below the Bonferroni threshold
F1-M.verdict: null: no evidence the F1 arm adds skill (pre-registered majority + Bonferroni rule not met)
